what.text: This page follows refugees from Lebanon living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 148 Lebanese refugees in Sweden, 1.5% of all refugees from Lebanon.
Germany hosts the most Lebanese refugees, followed by Canada, Denmark and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Lebanon in 1985 and 1986 and in 1989 and 1990.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in 2014, 2015 and 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 4616 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6624, at the end of 1993; the main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1998.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
